title: Patch: the language button leaves the top bar once a device has settled on its language, and lives on in settings
thread:
**Issue #1916 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1916: Patch: the language button leaves the top bar once a device has settled on its language, and lives on in settings
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Today the language button (`apps/web/src/i18n/LanguageButton.tsx`, #711, R711000) sits beside the settings gear on every screen, both in the top bar (`routes/nav.tsx`, `routes/landing.tsx`) and on the board (`game/Board.tsx`), for good. A newcomer needs it there. A player who has been reading in their language for a while does not, and for them it is clutter. Settings already has the same choice (`LanguageSelect` in `apps/web/src/settings/controls.tsx`).

Once a device has clearly settled on its language, the top-bar and board button go away and the Language row in settings is the only control left.

**How "settled" is measured.** Use the device, the way the language choice itself already works, not an IP or any other server-side fingerprint. R711000 makes the reader language presentation only: nothing about it reaches the server, and the client never sees an IP (CLAUDE.md rule 7). So:

- Keep a counter in `localStorage` (a key next to `jackioh.locale`, e.g. `jackioh.locale.settledVisits`), read and written inside try/catch like the locale key.
- Each time the app boots, add one to the counter. Any language change, from the button or from settings, sets it back to 0.
- When the counter reaches a named constant, `LANGUAGE_SETTLED_VISITS = 3`, in `i18n.ts` next to `LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY`, the device counts as settled. From then on, `LanguageButton` is no longer rendered in the nav, on the landing page or on the board.
- If storage is unavailable (private mode, blocked), the device never counts as settled and the button stays, so it is never lost.
- After a reset (the player changes language in settings), the button comes back until the device settles again.
- The settings hint, "The screens and the cards read in this language. The button at the top of every screen switches it too.", should only mention the button while the button is shown. Each sentence needs its `zh-CN.json` entry, which `i18n.test.ts` checks.

This is a decision the spec does not make yet. Add a new ruling note in this issue's block and amend R711000's text to point to it (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

### Acceptance

- A unit test, named after the new ruling, checks that the nav and the board render `language-nav` / `language-game` while the counter is below `LANGUAGE_SETTLED_VISITS`, and stop rendering them once it is reached.
- A language change, from the button or from settings' `setting-language`, sets the counter back to 0 and the button shows again.
- When storage throws, the button always shows.
- `setting-language` renders whatever the counter is, and its hint only mentions the top button while the button is shown. Every new `t()` literal has its `zh-CN.json` entry.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passes with the new note and R711000's amended text. Update the Board snapshot and `JlorePill.test.tsx` if the button's absence changes them.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

None. It follows #711.
```
